fact: The MFWA report, as relayed by The Nation, cites the suspension of international broadcasters in Burkina Faso (with Mali and Niger) over alleged bias; no date or outlet named, and the report spans six years, so as_of is the document's published date.

The Centre national de presse Norbert Zongo's digital-rights report says that in 2024 the suspension of certain international media continued to cover their online access, and the online platforms of RFI, France 24, Jeune Afrique and Le Monde, among others, remained inaccessible in Burkina Faso; the document does not name the ordering body or an end date.
